Background Remover – PNG Maker is designed so that your photos never leave your phone. This policy explains exactly what the app does and does not do with your data.
None. The app has no account system, no analytics, no advertising SDK and no crash-reporting service. We do not collect your name, email address, device identifiers, location or usage statistics.

Images you select are read only to remove their background, and all processing happens on your device using Google ML Kit\'s on-device segmentation models. Your images are never uploaded to us or to any third party. Your original file is never modified, moved or deleted.

A temporary working copy is created in the app\'s private cache while an image is being processed, and is deleted automatically. Results you choose to keep are stored in the app\'s private folder for the Recent Images screen, and — only when you tap Save PNG — a copy is written to Pictures/Background Remover in your gallery. You can delete either at any time.

The app uses the Android Photo Picker and the system file picker, which grant access to only the single file you choose, so no photo or media permission is requested. On Android 9 and older, saving to the gallery requires the storage permission; it is requested only at the moment you save. The app does not request internet access, and never reads contacts, SMS, call logs, location or any unrelated files.

The app uses Google ML Kit for image segmentation. The person-segmentation model is bundled inside the app and runs entirely offline. The general subject-segmentation model is delivered by Google Play services, which may download it once in the background; this transfers the model to your device and never sends your images anywhere. See Google\'s Privacy Policy for how Google Play services handles module downloads.
The app is a general-purpose photo utility. It collects no personal data from anyone, including children.
If this policy changes, the updated version will ship with a new release of the app and the date above will change.
Questions about this policy can be sent to the developer contact address listed on the app\'s Google Play store page.

Background Remover – PNG Maker detects the main subject of a photo with on-device AI segmentation, erases everything behind it, and exports a true transparent PNG. Your original photo is never modified.
All processing happens on your phone. No image is ever uploaded to a server and the app does not request internet access.
Powered by Google ML Kit on-device image segmentation.
